description: This Java class 'ClientScoresOverview' is a data container used within the Fineract project to represent an overview of client scores related to surveys. It includes fields such as survey name, id, likelihood code and name, score, poverty line, and date, with Lombok annotations to generate boilerplate code.

classes.name: ClientScoresOverview
classes.description: A data class representing an overview of client scores, including various identifying and scoring information related to survey responses.
